summary: JUNE 2026 verification iteration. Tested the 3 fixes shipped this session against LOCAL backend (http://localhost:8001) + web preview frontend. RESULTS: (1) BACKEND free-tier quota gate is BROKEN on the upload-text path — /api/statements/upload-text never calls _record_free_tier_use(), so free-plan users can decode unlimited times via paste. Reproduced via Mongo flip to plan='free': call #1 200 + job_id, call #2 ALSO 200 (expected 402). Confirmed user doc has no free_decode_last_at_ts after a successful upload-text. The /statements/upload (multipart) path DOES record correctly. The 402 payload shape on /statements/upload could not be exercised end-to-end because the OCR path requires a real file, but inspection of routes/statements.py confirms _check_free_tier_quota raises 402 with the expected {detail:{error:'free_tier_exhausted', message, retry_at_unix:int, redirect:'/pricing'}} + Retry-After header. Paid-plan (family) demo user CAN upload-text repeatedly — confirmed unchanged by the new gate. (2) Routes refactor sanity PASSED — GET /api/ (root) → 200, GET /api/statements → 200. NOTE: there is no /api/health endpoint (review request used wrong path; actual is /api/) and /api/users/me does not exist (actual is /api/auth/me). (3) FRONTEND settings sub-screens PASSED — Family members, Security, Summary Reports, Appearance all render the BackHeader (chevron + 'Back' label) with safe-area padding above. The Summary Reports title-escape bug is FIXED — title renders cleanly as 'Summary Reports', no literal backslash-quotes in the HTML. (4) FRONTEND Appearance → Text Size pills are still BROKEN on the web preview. After the supposed render-time fix in ThemedShell.tsx, tapping 'Largest' (text-size-xl) on /settings/appearance does NOT change the active pill's visual state (Default stays highlighted in the screenshot) and the measured fontSize of 'Reduce motion' stays at 17px through XL→SM→MD taps. Either the TouchableOpacity onPress isn't firing on web, or AccessibilityContext.setTextScale isn't reaching the consumer; in addition Text.render monkey-patch in ThemedShell silently no-ops on react-native-web (its line 18 early-returns when typeof origRender !== 'function', which is the case on RN-Web). Result: the headline bug this session was meant to fix is NOT actually fixed on web.

critical.issue: Free-tier quota gate is bypassed. routes/statements.py:244-263 upload_statement_text() calls _check_free_tier_quota() but NEVER calls _record_free_tier_use(user_id) before returning — so the user's free_decode_last_at_ts never gets stamped and every subsequent upload-text call passes the gate. Reproduced: after flipping demo to plan='free' and clearing the timestamp, two consecutive curl POSTs to /api/statements/upload-text both returned 200. Fix: add `await _record_free_tier_use(user_id)` right before `submit_upload_job(...)` (mirror the file-upload path at line 232).

minor.issue: Review request says GET /api/health and GET /api/users/me — neither exists. Actual routes are GET /api/ and GET /api/auth/me. Not a code issue, just a doc/contract mismatch worth fixing in the iteration spec.

Could not run a full negative test (multipart upload with sample bytes returns 422 because OCR needs a real PDF/image). Code inspection confirms the gate is enforced (line 206) but no automated test covers the file-path 402 branch.

ui_bugs.issue: FIRST tap of a different pill does NOT change text size on web. Measured fontSize of 'Reduce motion' label stayed 17px across baseline→XL→SM→MD taps; in the screenshots the 'Default' pill remains visually active even after tapping 'Largest'. The render-time Text.__waylyScale fix in ThemedShell.tsx line 42 is not reaching screen-level Text components — likely because Text.render monkey-patch at ThemedShell.tsx:18 silently no-ops on react-native-web (origRender is not a function), and the web fallback path (`zoom: scale` on the content wrapper) only kicks in when scale !== 1.0 — which requires the React state update to land first. This is the headline fix for this iteration and it does not work on the web preview.

integration_issues.issue: Banner sticks across every screen because background polls 401/404 against the production wayly.com.au backend (the api.ts override forces prod from this pod). Not a regression from this session — carry-over from iter_3.

react_native_issues.issue: Patch at /app/frontend/src/components/ThemedShell.tsx:12-32 silently no-ops on react-native-web because Text.render is not a function in RN-Web; the early return at line 18 hides this. Result: only the web-only zoom CSS path can scale text, and even that doesn't fire because the state change isn't propagating from the pill tap. Recommend: (a) gate the patch on Platform.OS !== 'web' or use Text.defaultProps/style override approach, (b) on web, ALWAYS apply zoom via CSS variable bound to scale and trigger a key remount when scale changes.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE BACKEND: routes/statements.py introduced two helpers (_check_free_tier_quota + _record_free_tier_use) but only WIRED THEM on the file-upload path (upload_statement at line 206 + line 232). The pasted-text path (upload_statement_text at line 251) checks the quota but never records it, so the rolling 30-day window never starts ticking. FIX: insert `await _record_free_tier_use(user_id)` between line 259 and line 260 in routes/statements.py (right before submit_upload_job is called). ROOT CAUSE FRONTEND: The session's fix moved `(Text as any).__waylyScale = a11y.scale;` from useEffect into render-time in ThemedShell.tsx:42, which is correct in theory — but the underlying Text.render monkey-patch at line 18-31 has an early return `if (typeof origRender !== 'function') return;` that fires on react-native-web (where Text doesn't expose a `render` static). So __waylyScale is being set, but no patched render ever reads it. Additionally the web-only `zoom: a11y.scale` fallback at line 56 only applies when `scale !== 1.0`, and even then it doesn't force a re-layout of children if the React state update from setTextScale isn't propagating through the tree. The visual evidence (Default pill remains active after tapping Largest in the screenshot) suggests the React state isn't even flipping — possibly the AccessibilityWidget z-index 9999 overlay or the dark-mode overlay is intercepting the touch on web. RECOMMENDED FIX: (a) wrap the patch in `if (Platform.OS !== 'web')` and on web rely solely on a `zoom` (or `fontSize` CSS variable) applied unconditionally to the content wrapper with a `key={scale}` to force a re-mount; (b) verify the TouchableOpacity onPress fires on web by adding a console.log in setTextScale; (c) consider adopting React Native's built-in accessibility scaling (`allowFontScaling` + system font scale) instead of the monkey-patch.
